newsitem.title: USA: Citicorp chairman gets smaller bonus.
newsitem.headline: Citicorp chairman gets smaller bonus.

text.p: Citicorp Chairman John Reed collected a $2 million bonus in 1996, smaller than the $3 million bonus awarded in each of the two prior years, according to the proxy statement for the company's annual meeting.
A spokesman said the smaller bonus reflected the fact that 1994 and 1995 were extraordinary years at Citicorp while 1996 was a good year.

In its report on compensation, the personnel committee of the board of directors noted that Reed's salary was increased to $1.5 million annualized in March, 1996, after being unchanged since March, 1994. The higher salary reflected Reed's "leadership in producing sustained levels of strong performance" and a review of the marketplace for chief executives. A table showed Reed's 1996 salary at $1.47 million compared to 1.30 million in 1995 and $1.28 million in 1994.

In January, 1997, Reed was awarded 10-year options for 182,000 Citicorp shares. Half of the options vest and can be exercised in three years, and the remainder vest and can be excercised four years from the date of the grant. The exercise price equals the average of the high and low share price on the date of the grant, which was $110.50 per share. The options although not vested are already "in the money" with Citicorp shares having recently hit a high of 126-1/2 but closing Wednesday at 121-7/8 reflecting a drop of 1-7/8 in a sharply lower overall stock marekt.
Reed also received $88,000 in cash compensation in 1996 in connection with a savings incentive plan.
The chairman's 1996 bonus was 75 percent cash and the rest was in "share units."
Although Reed received a smaller bonus the report listed him as owner of 1,021,624 shares. Based on Wednesday's share price, his stake is worth about $122 million.

Reed exercised options to acquire 679,000 shares in 1996 with $40.1 million in "value realized." The report said "value realized" is the market value of common stock acquired minus the exercise price.
